detail.longDescription:
Private AI. On your phone. Even without internet.

Offline AI Chat Private is a private AI chatbot and writing assistant powered by local LLM models on your Android phone. Download a model once, then ask questions, write, rewrite, summarize, translate, study, brainstorm, and work with documents even without a constant internet connection. Prompts, replies, chats, and attachments are processed locally on your device.

Use on-device AI for everyday chat, text generation, summaries, translation, writing help, document questions, study, reasoning, math, and coding. Compatible multimodal models can analyze photos, read text in images with OCR, and understand audio input. Features depend on the selected local model and your phone.

Choose the model that fits your phone and your needs:

Available local AI models:

• Tiny v2 (Granite 4.0 350M) — ~468 MB
• Quick (Gemma 4 E2B) — ~2.6 GB
• Smart (Gemma 4 E4B) — ~3.7 GB
• Compact (Phi-4 Mini) — ~3.8 GB

Premium models: Gemma 4 12B, Qwen2-VL-2B, DeepSeek R1 1.5B, Qwen2.5 1.5B, Qwen2.5 Coder 3B, Qwen3 0.6B, FLUX.2.

Premium also adds private on-device image generation and editing with FLUX.2, questions about text-based PDF documents, custom system prompts, chat export, and the ability to import compatible LiteRT local models. PDF text is extracted locally; scanned or password-protected PDFs are not supported. All saved chats remain free.

On your first run, the app can check your device and suggest a suitable model. You can skip this and choose any compatible model yourself.

Once a model is downloaded, AI chat and inference work offline. Internet may still be used for app installation and updates, model downloads, Google Play purchases and restores, and limited analytics or crash diagnostics when connected.

Your privacy comes first. Your conversations are processed on your phone instead of being sent to a cloud AI service for inference.

Local AI technology, CPU, and GPU:

Backend: Google LiteRT / LiteRT-LM · Acceleration: CPU / GPU

Local LLM inference uses the Google LiteRT and LiteRT-LM backend. Auto uses CPU by default for stability. Compatible phones can use GPU acceleration when GPU is selected or when experimental GPU probing is enabled. Image analysis requires a compatible vision model and a working GPU runtime. Speed, memory use, battery impact, and feature support depend on the model and device. Download sizes are approximate, and additional free storage is required.
